decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission P/2024/3556 dated 19/02/2025
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:
PP02 Rev C, PP03 Rev B, PP04 Rev B, PP05 Rev C, PP06 Rev D, PP07 Rev D 
received 29/07/2025
and shall conform in all other respects to the drawings and documentations approved under planning permission P/2024/3556
XD01, XD02, XD03, XD04, XD05, XD06, XD09, PP20, PP21 received 25/10/2024
PP01 Rev A, PP08 Rev B, PP09 Rev C received 27/01/2025 
P10 received 31/01/2025
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.
Condition : 4 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Reason: In order to ensure that adequate living standards are maintained and to protect neighbours' living conditions.
Condition : 5 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.
Reason: To ensure the proposal does not adversely impact on the amenity of the neighbouring properties in accordance with policies CC1 and CC2 (New Development) of the adopted Local Plan.
Condition : 6 - The construction hereby approved shall be in accordance with the details contained within the Construction Method Statement and Construction Management Plans as submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority as part of the application P/2025/1651 approved 02/09/2025
Reason: To ensure that the construction takes place in an acceptable manner and would not cause harm to neighbouring buildings or the wider area.
Condition : 7 - The railings and gates on the front boundary shall not be in-filled with solid material and shall be permanently retained as approved.
Reason:  To protect the appearance of the area and in the interests of read safety in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1, CC2, CC4, EC2 and SC7
Condition : 8 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: To ensure the proposal does not adversely impact on the amenity of the neighbouring properties in accordance with policies CC1 and CC2 of the adopted Local Plan.
